nodes.name: Fe3+ corrosion transformation
nodes.procedure: nickel foam (NF) is soaked in an environment with Fe3+ for several minutes to quickly prepare the Ni-Fe hydroxide nanosheets. The environmental conditions, such as the corrosion time and components, can significantly affect the Ni-Fe hydroxide nanosheets.

nodes.name: Chemical etching of LDHs
nodes.procedure: Acid and alkali etching, as typical chemical etching methods, can be applied to construct abundant active sites or provide atomic defects. alkali etching is applied to selectively etch Zn or Al in layered double hydroxides (LDHs). The obtained unsaturated coordinated Ni-Fe sites can decrease the Gibbs free energy of the oxygen evolution reaction (OER).

nodes.name: SRB microbial corrosion
nodes.procedure: anaerobic sulfate-reducing bacteria (SRB) are adopted to form iron sulfide-decorated NiFe-LDH. SRB use sulfate as the electron acceptor and reduce sulfates to sulfides.

nodes.name: IOB microbial corrosion
nodes.procedure: an IOB corrosion method for constructing NiFe-LDH integrated with iron oxides has been reported. Minerals can deposit on iron-oxidizing bacteria (IOB) and form iron oxides.
